cards.title: Hands-On Dads and a More Peaceful World
cards.body: Pioneering scientist Sarah Blaffer Hrdy has rewritten the story of evolution by unpicking Darwinian sexism. She now turns her attention to how involved fatherhood could shape a more peaceful society.

cards.title: Adult Son Moving Back Home: Mothering Reset
cards.body: When adult children return to the family nest post-graduation, parents face shifting dynamics and rediscovered parenting challenges. Emma Beddington explores how to navigate this unexpected phase of motherhood.

cards.title: Should Parents Let Kids Play Grand Theft Auto?
cards.body: With Grand Theft Auto 6's release, parents face questions about its impact on their children. Experts weigh in on what families should know before allowing kids access to this major video game.

cards.title: Teen Online Safety: What Teens Hide From Parents
cards.body: Research surveying 30 young people reveals what teens hide from their parents online and what would encourage more openness. Parents can use these insights to support both safety and well-being.

cards.title: Should Parents Genetically Enhance Their Children?
cards.body: As genetic editing becomes possible, parents face an ethical question: should they edit genes to pick the best possible child? Experts explore the implications of genetic enhancement for families.

cards.title: Messages Asexual Women Hear About Motherhood
cards.body: Research reveals how asexual women are repeatedly told they'll change their minds about motherhood. These persistent messages shape identities, relationships, and deeply personal life choices.

cards.title: The Power of Play and Second Chances for Kids
cards.body: Whether children seize second chances often depends on whether interest and enjoyment—or fear and shame—drive their decision-making. Play and positive experiences are key to encouraging growth.
